title: Korean Kale Curry
description: A flavorful and nutritious curry made with kale and inspired by Korean cuisine. This dish combines the crunch of kale with the warm, aromatic spices of Korean curry.

ingredients.name: kale
ingredients.amount: 2 cups, stems removed and discarded, leaves chopped

instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the ginger and garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the kale and cook for 3-4 minutes, until wilted.
Add the jammed and dense, and stir to combine.
Serve hot, garnished with additional kale if desired.
